topic: NELA data entry and case ascertainment

audits.title: EP.FRI.857 Audit and quality improvement project; data entry into the NELA database from Royal Stoke university hospital
audits.standard: National Emergency Laparotomy Audit case ascertainment and complete data entry

cycle1.result: 45 of 68 laparotomies entered on NELA; only 1 had a complete data set, 22 had 87% and 22 had <50% fields completed.

cycle2.result: Case ascertainment rose to 54% and all entries were complete and locked.

audits.other_findings: Earlier data (December 2018 to November 2019) suggested case ascertainment of 21% (84 vs 392).
audits.citation: Nair N, Kalatzis V, Gudipati M, Gaunt A, Machineni V. EP.FRI.857 Audit and quality improvement project; data entry into the NELA database from Royal Stoke university hospital. British Journal of Surgery. 2021;108(Supplement_7). doi:10.1093/bjs/znab312.127.

audits.title: 986 Is the NELA Section on the CEPOD Form Completed for General Surgical Patients Upon Emergency Theatre Booking? - a Closed-Loop Audit
audits.standard: National Emergency Laparotomy Audit requirement to assess all emergency surgical patients for inclusion
audits.setting: General surgery, Portsmouth University Hospitals NHS Trust

cycle1.result: 42.7% of CEPOD forms included the completed NELA section.

audits.intervention: Formal emails to surgical junior doctors, informal discussions with doctors and nurses, and posters near where CEPOD forms are collected.
audits.other_findings: Newly rotated doctors lacked understanding of NELA's importance.
audits.citation: Noor M, Fernandes E, Hirri F, Hunter M, Richardson J. 986 Is the NELA Section on the CEPOD Form Completed for General Surgical Patients Upon Emergency Theatre Booking? - a Closed-Loop Audit. British Journal of Surgery. 2024;111(Supplement_6). doi:10.1093/bjs/znae163.287.

audits.title: eP55 Nela Compliance in A District General Hospital: A Clinical Re-Audit
audits.standard: National Emergency Laparotomy Audit (NELA) data entry for all emergency laparotomies
audits.setting: District general hospital, Isle of Wight NHS Trust

cycle1.result: 66% (n=73) of laparotomies entered into the NELA database.

audits.intervention: Surgical registrars added to the NELA team, redesigned theatre booking form and continuity of team roles during doctors' inductions
audits.citation: Unadike C, Itoko T, Aweke G, Rutter P. eP55 Nela Compliance in A District General Hospital: A Clinical Re-Audit. British Journal of Surgery. 2025;112(Supplement_1). doi:10.1093/bjs/znae318.041.

audits.title: eP71 Audit of Emergency Laparotomy Workload in a District General Hospital: Are We Compliant with NELA Data Entry?
audits.standard: NELA requirement: all emergency laparotomies registered and submitted by the deadline
audits.setting: District general hospital, North Manchester General Hospital; emergency laparotomies

cycle1.result: 31 (50%) entered; 4 (13%) met submission deadline; 18 (67%) registered more than 6 months after discharge; average delay 206 days.

cycle2.result: 84% registered in Year 9 and 95% in Year 10; average time to entry 100 days; all submitted before the deadline.

audits.other_findings: Year 9 had 75 and Year 10 had 38 patients.
audits.citation: Itaman U, Shahrokhi N, Anam F, Barghash M, Dalmia S. eP71 Audit of Emergency Laparotomy Workload in a District General Hospital: Are We Compliant with NELA Data Entry?. British Journal of Surgery. 2025;112(Supplement_1). doi:10.1093/bjs/znae318.052.

audits.title: 193 Breaking Barriers in Achieving Excellence for National Emergency Laparotomy Audit (NELA) Documentation: A Successful Quality Improvement Framework
audits.standard: Emergency Laparotomy Best Practice Tariff 2023–2025: ≥85% formal mortality risk assessment documented on NELA
audits.setting: Queen Elizabeth the Queen Mother Hospital, East Kent Hospitals University NHS Foundation Trust
audits.intervention: Presentations at surgical and anaesthetic clinical governance meetings, surveys, NELA log-in details at trainee induction, and a QR code on the CEPOD booking form.

cycle2.result: 86.2% (n=50) using the NELA tool, achieving the ≥85% target.

audits.other_findings: Two PDSA cycles over one year; future plans involve the POPS team and IT department.
audits.citation: Andrei Saw Ye Jeune G, Abdelsaid K, Bugren S, Boshnaq M. 193 Breaking Barriers in Achieving Excellence for National Emergency Laparotomy Audit (NELA) Documentation: A Successful Quality Improvement Framework. British Journal of Surgery. 2025;112(Supplement_10). doi:10.1093/bjs/znaf128.536.
